title: Microsoft Purview Data Security Investigations: personal data examination
summary: Hold: the instructions for running an examination start inside an investigation without explaining how to reach it from the portal. The roadmap details, consumption billing and control-table paths are supported, but the assurance that examination collects nothing new needs narrowing to the documented analysis of selected items.

claims.claim: DSI introduces a Personal data examination focus area.
claims.quote: Data Security Investigations (DSI) is introducing a new examination focus area concentrated on identifying personal data.

claims.claim: The examination uses AI to identify and extract personal data.
claims.quote: After the AI finishes processing the selected data items, you can review the personal data examinations to identify personal data details for each item.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Personal data examination analyzes selected items already included in the investigation scope.
claims.quote: Complete the following steps to identify personal data in items included in the investigation scope:

claims.claim: Credentials is another examination focus area.
claims.quote: Credentials: Credentials processing examines and extracts credentials and access assets included in selected data items.

claims.claim: Risk examination is another available focus area.
claims.quote: Risks: Risks processing analyzes and scores selected data items for active risks.

claims.claim: Mitigation is another examination focus area.
claims.quote: Mitigation: Mitigation processing identifies specific threats and recommends mitigation steps for selected data items.

claims.claim: Custom is another examination focus area.
claims.quote: Custom: Define a custom examination focus area using a natural language prompt to describe what you want AI to analyze.

claims.claim: The route for running an examination starts in an investigation at Analysis, then selects items, Examine and Personal data in Choose a focus area.
claims.quote: 1. Go to Data Security Investigations in the Microsoft Purview portal ... 2. Select Investigations in the left navigation. 3. Select an investigation, and then select Analysis on the navigation bar.
claims.fix: Replace 'in an investigation, open Analysis' with 'in the Microsoft Purview portal, open Data Security Investigations, select Investigations, select an investigation, and then open Analysis'. Keep the subsequent item selection, Examine and Personal data focus-area instructions. The missing entry route is documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/data-security-investigations-personal-data.
